summary_md: **Apurv Sheldiya ([@Apurv35904761](https://x.com/Apurv35904761/status/2116445873324621900))** summarizes *Prefix Executability* by Rezaeian et al. ([arXiv 2610.40444](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40444)), which scores whether every prefix of an agent's tool-call trajectory remains executable under schemas, preconditions and data dependencies rather than only final success.

referenced_urls.title: Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
